title: Meenakshi Traders v. Rajan & Sons
text: The complainant instituted this criminal complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act alleging dishonour of a cheque of Rs 3,50,000 issued by the drawer, Rajan & Sons. The cheque was returned unpaid with the endorsement 'Payment Stopped by Drawer'. The stoppage of payment is treated as equivalent to dishonour under the Negotiable Instruments Act. A demand notice was served personally on the proprietor. The accused contended that the cheque was obtained by coercion; however, no FIR was lodged for extortion prior to receiving the notice, undermining this defence. The complainant proved the transaction through invoices and delivery receipts. The court holds the accused held guilty under Section 138 NI Act. Sentence: fine of Rs 7,00,000 payable within two months, failing which one year simple imprisonment. Appeal against this order shall lie to the Sessions Court.
